top_band: white/light blue snow roof on rows 1-9
evidence: The object shows a distinct snow-covered sloped/horizontal roof band at rows 1-9 (with a white ridge highlight at row 6 and overhanging icicles at rows 9-10) above a vertical wooden lattice front face at rows 10-25. However, it is a built wooden structure/prop with snow on top, not an organic object (plants, rocks, firewood).

style.evidence: The snow roof has good multi-step blue-white shading and icicle details, and the dark frames use tinted dark tones. However, the tan panels on the front face (rows 10-12, 15-16, 19-22) are completely flat single-color fills (4x4 to 18x2 blocks of one color) with zero wood grain or shading variation compared to the rich texture of the reference stalls.
